sampling_method: Random diagonal sampling of 10-20 hills; part canopy and tap stem bases over standing water or white tray
primary_source_reference: ICAR-NRRI Cuttack Technical Bulletin No. 12: Pest Management in Rice Ecosystem; OUAT Kharif Rice Package of Practices
regional_or_stage_qualification: Odisha irrigated & shallow lowlands; applies to early vegetative tillering before canopy closure

sampling_method: Random diagonal sampling of 10-20 hills at plant base during morning hours
primary_source_reference: ICAR-NRRI Cuttack: Rice Knowledge Management Portal (RKMP); Directorate of Rice Research (IIRR)
regional_or_stage_qualification: Canopy closure to grain ripening; predatory mirid bugs and spiders must be assessed before spray

sampling_method: Sample 100 randomly selected tillers across 10 hills; count dead central shoots easily pulled out
primary_source_reference: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage (DPPQS) IPM Package for Paddy; ICAR-NRRI Cuttack
regional_or_stage_qualification: Active tillering stage; Dead heart symptoms visible 7-10 days after larval entry

sampling_method: Visual inspection of leaf tips and blades in 1m x 1m quadrat for felt-covered oval egg clusters
primary_source_reference: ICAR-NRRI Cuttack Rice IPM Technical Manual
regional_or_stage_qualification: Pre-tillering and active tillering; egg parasitism by Trichogramma must be monitored

sampling_method: Visual count of erect white sterile empty panicles per 100 panicles observed
primary_source_reference: ICAR-NRRI / OUAT Bhubaneswar Kharif Package of Practices
regional_or_stage_qualification: Booting to grain filling; late intervention has limited curative efficacy once whitehead emerges

sampling_method: Inspect 10 random hills diagonally across field; count longitudinally stitched leaves harboring live larvae
primary_source_reference: ICAR-National Research Centre for Integrated Pest Management (NCIPM) Rice Package; ICAR-NRRI
regional_or_stage_qualification: Tillering stage; plant can easily compensate for vegetative foliage loss if predatory wasps present

sampling_method: Inspect upper canopy flag leaves on 10 random hills; check for larval feeding on flag leaf blade
exact_threshold_and_operator: >= 1.0 damaged flag leaf/hill (or >= 5.0% flag leaf damage)
primary_source_reference: ICAR-NRRI Cuttack Guidelines for Protecting Flag Leaf in High-Yielding Rice
regional_or_stage_qualification: Critical reproductive gate; flag leaf contributes >50% of photosynthates to developing grains

sampling_method: Inspect 10 hills in early morning; count spiny blue-black beetles resting on leaves
primary_source_reference: OUAT Bhubaneswar & ICAR-NRRI: Management of Rice Hispa Outbreaks in Coastal Odisha
regional_or_stage_qualification: Endemic to coastal Odisha districts (Cuttack, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara, Puri)

sampling_method: Count leaves displaying parallel white epidermal scrape lines across 100 examined leaves
primary_source_reference: DPPQS Integrated Pest Management Package for Paddy; ICAR-NRRI
regional_or_stage_qualification: Applies to vegetative foliage; must distinguish feeding scrapes from blast lesions

sampling_method: Inspect 1m x 1m quadrats in field; count severed panicles dropped to ground in late afternoon/dusk
primary_source_reference: ICAR-NRRI Cuttack Rice Knowledge Management Portal; DPPQS Guidelines
regional_or_stage_qualification: Maturescent/heading stage; true ear-cutting damage requires emergency intervention

sampling_method: Inspect plant base, leaf sheaths, and soil crevices during dawn/dusk for nocturnal larvae
primary_source_reference: Extrapolated from swarming caterpillar (Spodoptera mauritia) nursery threshold; NOT verified for M. separata in Odisha POP
regional_or_stage_qualification: Foliar defoliation in early tillering; plants can re-tiller; no official hill threshold in OUAT POP

sampling_method: Search 10 hills for larvae hiding near panicle neck or in soil crevices during dusk
primary_source_reference: Ad-hoc conversion of 1-2 larvae/m² based on assumed 25 hills/m² density; NOT documented as per_hill standard in CIBRC/OUAT
regional_or_stage_qualification: Ad-hoc unit conversion violates DPPQS standard of clipped_panicles/m²
